name: Partnership Agreement
description: Agreement between two companies collaborating commercially, covering obligations, referral and revenue arrangements, branding and confidentiality.

coverPage.title: Partnership Agreement
coverPage.intro: This Partnership Agreement (the “Agreement”) consists of: (1) this Cover Page (“**Cover Page**”) and (2) the Common Paper Partnership Agreement Standard Terms (“**Standard Terms**”). Any modifications of the Standard Terms should be made on the Cover Page, which will control over conflicts with the Standard Terms.
coverPage.attestation: By signing this Cover Page, each party agrees to enter into this Agreement as of the Effective Date.

fields.label: Company
fields.prompt: the company's legal entity name, the signatory's name and title, and a notice address.

fields.label: Partner
fields.prompt: the partner's legal entity name, the signatory's name and title, and a notice address.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.prompt: the date the partnership starts, as yyyy-mm-dd.

fields.label: End Date
fields.prompt: when the partnership ends, such as "31 December 2027" or "2 years from the Effective Date".

fields.label: Obligations
fields.prompt: what each party has agreed to do. Take both sides.

fields.label: Territory
fields.prompt: where the partner may use the company's brand, such as "the United States and Canada".

fields.label: Payment Schedule
fields.prompt: when payments fall due, if either party pays the other.

fields.label: Payment Process
fields.prompt: how payments are billed and settled.

fields.label: Brand Guidelines
fields.prompt: where the brand guidelines can be read, such as a URL.

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.prompt: the full name of the US state whose law governs, such as "Delaware". Always a state, never a country or a city.

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.prompt: the courts that hear disputes, such as "the state and federal courts located in New Castle County, Delaware".

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.prompt: the most either party can be made to pay, such as "$100,000" or "the fees paid in the 12 months before the claim".

fields.label: Increased Claims
fields.prompt: which kinds of claim carry a higher cap, if any. Usually none.

fields.label: Increased Cap Amount
fields.prompt: the higher cap that applies to Increased Claims, if there are any.

fields.label: Unlimited Claims
fields.prompt: which kinds of claim have no cap at all, if any. Usually none.

fields.label: Company Covered Claims
fields.prompt: the third-party claims the company indemnifies the partner against, beyond the standard ones. Usually none.

fields.label: Partner Covered Claims
fields.prompt: the third-party claims the partner indemnifies the company against, beyond the standard ones. Usually none.

fields.label: Additional Warranties
fields.prompt: any warranties beyond the standard terms. Usually none.

fields.label: DPA
fields.prompt: the data processing agreement between the parties, if they have one. Usually none.
